runs.name: create mixed
runs.sql: CREATE TABLE dbo.merge_top_mix(id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,n INT NOT NULL)

runs.name: mixed top zero reset
runs.sql: TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.merge_top_mix; INSERT dbo.merge_top_mix(id,n) VALUES (1,10),(2,20),(3,30)

runs.name: mixed top zero merge
runs.sql:
MERGE TOP (0) dbo.merge_top_mix AS t USING (VALUES (1,11),(2,22),(4,44)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id
       WHEN MATCHED AND s.id=1 THEN UPDATE SET n=s.n
       WHEN MATCHED AND s.id=2 THEN DELETE
       WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n)
       WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE AND t.id=3 THEN DELETE
       OUTPUT $action AS action, inserted.id AS inserted_id, deleted.id AS deleted_id;

runs.sql:
DECLARE @n INT=2; MERGE TOP (@n) dbo.merge_top_forms AS t
       USING (VALUES (1,10),(2,20),(3,30)) AS s(id,n) ON t.id=s.id
       WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (id,n) VALUES (s.id,s.n)
       OUTPUT $action AS action, inserted.id AS inserted_id, deleted.id AS deleted_id;

runs.name: variable top rowcount
runs.sql: SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS affected

runs.name: variable top rows
runs.sql: SELECT id,n FROM dbo.merge_top_forms ORDER BY id
